scope: Deterministic device doubles; not a physical webcam, acoustic, or model accuracy test.

checks.test: Voice is OFF initially and preparing text never starts audio
Prepared transcript remains available when voice is off
Speech queue is segmented into bounded utterances
Local Spanish voice is selected by default
End event advances to next sentence exactly once
Pause keeps queue and pauses synthesis
Resume continues the same reading queue
Stop invalidates pending callbacks and empties the queue
Changing voice preferences cancels current speech safely
Notifications do not interrupt ongoing narration
Blocked browser audio reports an error with transcript preserved
Disabling voice cancels and returns to OFF
Remote-only voices are refused until user opt-in
Remote voice becomes available only after opt-in
Revoking remote consent prevents subsequent remote speech
Missing system voices fail gracefully
Insecure origin cannot request a camera
Permission denial produces a recoverable error
Camera requests explicitly disable microphone
Cancelling pending permission stops any subsequently returned stream
Successful camera lifecycle owns one video stream
Worker results are delivered to the gesture callback
Repeated activation cannot create a second stream
Stop releases stream, worker, preview and pending frame state
Device disconnection stops camera and reports an error
Video startup failure does not leak the camera stream
Model resource failure stops capture rather than leaving camera on
Repeated inference errors trigger camera shutdown
Default assets are version-pinned, not latest
Local installation loads model and WASM from the same origin
